editorial_notes: Written about the PREVIOUS edition, from published reporting on it, to help a reader decide on the next one. No rating: the sources are news reports and organiser statements, which describe how an event was run, not how runners rated it. A score needs participant evidence -- race reports, runner blogs, attributed quotes -- and without it would be invention.
title: Astra Half Marathon 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
seo_title: Astra Half Marathon 2026 Review | BSD, Tangerang
meta_description: Astra Half Marathon review: more than 5,000 runners at BSD in 2025, eight hydration points, twelve ambulances and cover for injuries. What to expect in 2026.
dek: One of the better-resourced corporate races in Greater Jakarta: more than 5,000 runners in 2025, twelve ambulances on the route, eight hydration points and insurance for every entrant. Here is what the last edition was like.
verdict: The Astra Half Marathon is a corporate race that puts real money into the runner experience. The 2025 edition on 30 November at Astra Biz Center, BSD, drew more than 5,000 runners across 5 km, 10 km and the half [1], and its published support is unusually thorough: twelve ambulances, seven mobile medics, eight hydration points, two fruit stations, two sponging stations and nine cheering areas [1], plus hospital cover for injuries and life insurance for every participant [1]. Part of ticket revenue went to disaster relief in Sumatra [1]. For a first half marathon in the Jakarta area, it is hard to find one better supported.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: The 2025 race was held on 30 November at Astra Biz Center in BSD, Tangerang, and drew more than 5,000 runners across three distances: 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon [1]. It ran under the theme "Together in Motion" [1].
BSD is a planned township south-west of Jakarta, and its wide, orderly roads are a large part of why it has become a popular base for road races in the region.

sections.heading: The Support on the Course
paragraphs: What stands out is the scale of the published support. The organisers listed twelve ambulances positioned along the route and at race central, seven mobile medics, eight hydration points, two fruit stations and two sponging stations [1].
Sponging stations are worth noting specifically. In Jakarta's heat and humidity, somewhere to cool down with water is as useful as somewhere to drink it.
There were also nine cheering areas along the route [1], which matters more than it sounds on a course through a business district that would otherwise be quiet at dawn.

sections.heading: Insurance and Charity
paragraphs: Every entrant was covered: hospital compensation of up to Rp2.5 million for sports injuries, and Rp25 million of life insurance for all participants [1]. It is the kind of detail most races leave out, and a reasonable signal of how seriously the organisers take the event.

Under a campaign called "We Run, We Care, We Share", part of ticket sales was donated to communities affected by disasters in Sumatra [1]. Prizes across the event were worth Rp200 million in total, including a Honda ICON e electric scooter [1].

sections.heading: What to Expect in 2026
paragraphs: The 2026 edition is scheduled for Sunday 29 November, again at Astra Biz Center and again over 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon [2]. It runs under a new theme, "Berkarya dan Tumbuh Bersama Indonesia", as part of the Astra group's run-up to its seventieth anniversary [2].
Nothing published suggests the support model is changing, though the specifics -- number of hydration points, insurance terms -- are announced each year and worth checking once they appear.

sections.heading: Should You Enter?
paragraphs: Yes, particularly for a first half marathon. The combination of a flat planned township, generous on-course support and insurance cover makes it one of the lower-risk ways to run the distance in the Jakarta area.
Experienced runners chasing a fast time will find it a solid, well-run race rather than a destination one. It is at its best as a dependable, well-supported half on familiar roads.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the previous edition and the organisers' own announcements. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.

faqs.question: How many people ran the Astra Half Marathon in 2025?
faqs.answer: More than 5,000 runners took part on 30 November 2025 at Astra Biz Center in BSD, Tangerang, across the 5 km, 10 km and half marathon. It ran under the theme "Together in Motion".

faqs.question: What support is there on the Astra Half Marathon course?
faqs.answer: In 2025 the organisers listed twelve ambulances, seven mobile medics, eight hydration points, two fruit stations, two sponging stations and nine cheering areas. That is unusually thorough for a race of this size and particularly useful in Jakarta's heat.

faqs.question: Are runners insured at the Astra Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: Yes. In 2025 every participant was covered with hospital compensation of up to Rp2.5 million for sports injuries and Rp25 million of life insurance. Terms for the 2026 edition are announced separately and are worth checking once published.
